papers.title_en: StepControl: Long-Horizon Human Motion Generation from Foot-Contact Schedules
papers.authors: Hojun Jang, Jinseok Bae, Donggeun Lim, Taesun Kim, Seungbin Jeong, Younghwan Lee, Yong Seok Kim, Young Min Kim
papers.evidence: 自回归扩散模型生成长期人体动作
papers.tldr: 可控人体动作生成多关注指定动作或身体位置，本文转向仅规定左右脚何时触地。StepControl用自回归扩散模型，以未来二值足部触地时序为条件，经专用交叉注意力和无分类器引导注入接触事件，并用混合噪声与预热稳定长时生成。实验表明其触地时序跟随优于改造现有空间引导生成器，且支持步频变化、走走停停、跛行和双脚跳等编辑。结果说明极简足部接触计划可作为直观有效的时间控制接口。
papers.abstract_en: Controllable human motion generation has largely focused on specifying what action should occur or where the body should move. We study a complementary question: can full-body motion be controlled by specifying only when each foot contacts the ground? We introduce StepControl, an autoregressive diffusion model conditioned on a future binary left/right foot-contact schedule, without requiring target root and body poses, or semantic prompts. StepControl represents contact as explicit temporal events and injects them through dedicated cross-attention with classifier-free guidance. We further introduce a stochastic mixture noise schedule and warmup strategy for stable long-horizon autoregressive generation. Experiments show that StepControl follows prescribed contact timing more accurately than adapting existing spatially guided motion generators to contact constraints. It maintains effective contact control over long continuous rollouts and responds to edited schedules such as cadence changes, stop-and-go pauses, limping gaits, and bilateral jumping. Our results show that minimal foot-contact schedules provide an effective and intuitive temporal interface for controllable motion generation.

papers.title_en: ETA-Motion: Efficient Topology-Agnostic Motion Diffusion via Sparse Joint Learning
papers.evidence: 基于扩散的稀疏关节拓扑无关三维动作生成
papers.tldr: 拓扑无关动作生成需要为任意骨架合成动作，但关节配置与语义不一致，现有全关节稠密建模计算昂贵且难以迁移。ETA-Motion 提出稀疏关节学习，仅用紧凑关节子集训练扩散生成器，降低冗余并促进跨拓扑模式共享。方法还引入融合文本与视觉线索的语义关节嵌入，以及保持骨架结构的拓扑感知训练目标。实验表明其优于现有基线，显著提升效率，并能泛化到未见动作与骨架，为跨骨架生成提供高效方案。
papers.abstract_en: Topology-agnostic motion generation aims to synthesize motions for diverse characters with arbitrary skeletons. Unlike conventional motion generation, which assumes a fixed skeletal template, this setting must handle diverse joint configurations and inconsistent joint semantics across characters. Existing methods address this challenge through dense full-joint modeling, which incurs substantial computational cost and hinders learning transferable motion patterns across diverse skeletal topologies. We present ETA-Motion, a topology-agnostic motion generation framework based on sparse joint learning. Instead of learning motion from all joints, our method uses a compact subset of joints to reduce redundancy and trains the motion generator on the resulting sparse skeleton. To facilitate correspondence across diverse topologies, we introduce semantic joint embeddings that combine textual and visual cues, together with topology-aware training objectives for preserving skeletal structure. Although ETA-Motion is trained only on sparse skeletal observations, it supports full-skeleton motion generation during inference. Experimental results demonstrate that ETA-Motion outperforms existing topology-agnostic baselines while significantly improving efficiency and generalization to unseen motions and unseen topologies.

papers.authors: Gerrit Gerhartz, Francesco Alesiani, Jonathan Warrell, Henrik Christiansen, Matheus Ferraz, Mathias Niepert
papers.evidence: 面向Flow Matching与随机插值的速度场精确组合
papers.tldr: 扩散模型能用条件分数精确做逻辑引导，但Flow Matching与随机插值学习速度场，合取等组合在非高斯路径上会有漂移交互误差，组合速度未必采样逻辑目标。LOGSI以分数再平衡为原理机制，在非高斯桥中交替传输与再平衡，并用高斯路径速度规则作近似传输预测。在图像迁移和QM9分子编辑上，同预算下它提升规则符合度并改善图像保真度。该工作为随机插值的逻辑引导提供了统一方案。
papers.abstract_en: Guidance and composition of generative models have applications in visual design, chemistry, and biology. Logical guidance composes conditional scores exactly for diffusion models. However, Flow Matching (FM) and Stochastic Interpolants (SI) learn velocity fields. We show that negation and exclusive disjunction admit exact conditional velocity composition on any interpolant, whereas conjunction, and therefore any formula containing one, is exact on Gaussian paths but in general incurs a drift-interaction error, so composed velocities need not sample the logical target. LOGSI solves this by using score-based re-equilibration as our principled mechanism and falling back to the Gaussian-path velocity rule as an approximate transport predictor. In non-Gaussian bridge problems, generation alternates transport steps with score re-equilibration steps. On image trans fer (EMNIST to CMNIST, CelebA) and QM9 source-to-target molecular editing with logical attribute constraints, LOGSI improves rule conformity at the same network-evaluation budget over composed-velocity baselines, while also improving fidelity on the image tasks. More broadly, LOGSI applies wherever stochastic interpolants need guidance and logical combinations of constraints are natural.

papers.title_en: WorldFlow: Joint Video and 3D Motion Prediction via Large-Scale Pretraining
papers.authors: Yuhao Lu, Jiongxu Chen, Hexiang Wei, Jiajin Wu, Juelin Li, Mingjian Liang, Fan Yang, Zhuowei Liang, Zihao Liu, Zhennan Wang, Sheng Wang, Lin Shao
papers.evidence: 整流流生成模型联合预测视频与3D运动
papers.tldr: 现有视频世界模型把3D动力学隐含在像素中，基于动作的建模又与特定机器人构型绑定，而纯光流监督信号有限。WorldFlow将3D运动参数化为与视频网格对齐的连续位移token，用统一Mixture-of-Transformers骨干在rectified-flow目标下联合去噪视频与查询式3D轨迹。模型在144万对象级样本上预训练，并构建WorldFlowBench；在三个评测集上平均位移误差最低，SpatialCog集ADE为0.060米，较最强外部基线降低54.2%。该工作把显式几何动力学与视觉演化耦合，释放了预训练视频模型中的物理常识。
papers.abstract_en: Predicting future physical states stands as a central challenge in embodied intelligence. Existing video world models leave 3D dynamics implicit, action-based formulations remain tied to specific robot configurations, and 3D motion prediction models use flow-only supervision, providing a limited learning signal for physical dynamics. To circumvent these limitations, we introduce \method{}, a generative world model that jointly predicts future video and query-based 3D trajectories. By parameterizing 3D motion as continuous displacement tokens aligned with the video grid, a unified Mixture-of-Transformers (MoT) backbone jointly denoises both modalities under a rectified-flow objective. This formulation couples explicit geometric dynamics with visual evolution, effectively unlocking the physical commonsense embedded within pretrained video models. To empirically scale and validate this unified architecture, we train \method{} on a heterogeneous mixture of 1.44 million object-level samples spanning simulated and real-world domains. We further introduce WorldFlowBench, comprising 1,678 evaluation samples from 11 data sources across simulated and real-world interactions, including spatial reasoning tasks. Across all three evaluation sets, WorldFlow achieves the lowest average displacement error (ADE) and final displacement error (FDE) among the evaluated learning-based methods. Notably, on the challenging SpatialCog set, WorldFlow achieves an ADE of 0.060 m, a 54.2\% reduction compared with the strongest external baseline. It also reduces ADE and FDE by 55.9\% and 68.5\%, respectively, compared with its flow-only variant. Project page: https://worldflow-rbs.github.io/.

papers.authors: Mateo Clémente, Léo Maxime Brunswic, Rui Heng Yang, Amir Rasouli
papers.evidence: 流匹配生成的理论分析与耦合引导
papers.tldr: 扩散模型中的引导方法能提升生成可控性，但直接迁移到流匹配会破坏训练时的耦合分布，导致采样控制不稳定。作者从几何视角提出 Coupled Guidance，利用流匹配训练固有的耦合结构设计专用引导机制。在机器人碰撞避免、Adroit 灵巧操作及图像修复/超分/去模糊任务上，该方法提升样本质量与引导稳定性且无额外开销。该工作为流匹配提供了更可靠的理论解释与通用引导方案。
papers.abstract_en: Guidance methods are essential tools for steering the generation process in diffusion models, improving the generalizability of stochastic robotic controllers and enabling high-quality controlled image synthesis. Despite strong parallels between flow-matching and diffusion, integrating guidance into flow-matching models remains quite challenging. Recent work has proposed general guidance frameworks for flow-matching, however, they are direct adaptations of diffusion guidance methods and can prove unstable. In this work, we conduct a theoretical analysis of guidance in flow-matching and show that a naive translation of diffusion-based guidance to flow-matching breaks the coupling distribution used during training, resulting in weaker control over sampling accuracy. Building on this insight, we propose Coupled Guidance, a flow-matching-specific guidance mechanism derived from a geometric perspective that leverages the coupling structure inherent to flow-matching training. To validate the effectiveness of our approach, we conduct extensive experimentation on a custom robotic collision avoidance task using ManiSkill3, four robotic dexterous manipulation tasks from the Adroit benchmark, and three image generation tasks, namely inpainting, super-resolution, and deblurring, using the ImageNet-128 and CelebA-HQ-256 datasets. Our findings show that our framework improves sample quality and guidance stability across all tasks, without imposing any additional overhead.

papers.title_en: Composing and Steering Diffusion Models with Generalized Feynman-Kac Correctors
papers.evidence: 组合与引导预训练扩散模型的原理性框架
papers.tldr: 扩散模型常需从多个预训练模型的组合分布或带奖励倾斜的目标中采样，但直接相加分数会产生错误样本，现有校正方法适用范围有限。本文提出广义 Feynman-Kac 校正器（GFKC），用几何插值构造满足 Feynman-Kac PDE 的势函数并给出闭式表达，同时推广对数概率 ODE 在生成过程中跟踪各模型密度。算法完全在对数域运行，可即时校正并支持奖励引导，无需重训练或微调。在解析高斯模型上贴近真实目标，在 MNIST 上实现非平凡模型组合与有效引导。
papers.abstract_en: Diffusion models have become the leading paradigm in generative modeling, yet many applications require sampling from distributions that are not those of any single pretrained model, but are instead defined through combinations of several models, possibly tilted toward high values of a downstream reward. Naively combining the scores of the models yields incorrect samples, while existing corrections are restricted to specific families of targets. In this work, we introduce the generalized Feynman-Kac correctors (GFKC), a principled framework for sampling from an arbitrary target function of several pretrained diffusion models. We show that the geometric interpolation between an arbitrary initial function and the target function of the models satisfies a Feynman--Kac partial differential equation, and derive its potential in closed form. To evaluate this potential during generation, we further generalize the log-probability ODE to track the density of each model along trajectories driven by a different velocity field. The resulting algorithm operates entirely in the log domain, incorporates reward-based steering at no additional conceptual cost, and corrects the generation on the fly, without retraining or fine-tuning the models. We validate the method on analytic Gaussian models, where it closely matches the ground-truth targets, and on diffusion models trained on MNIST, where it samples from non-trivial combinations of the models and enables effective steering.

papers.title_en: PosePlaner: Denoising Any Feed-Forward Pose Predictor from Pairwise Planar Geometry
papers.authors: Yihang Chen, Bin Tan, Yujun Shen, Yinghao Xu, Nan Xue
papers.evidence: 利用流匹配从平面几何精化相机位姿
papers.tldr: 多视图Transformer把匹配、几何与位姿压缩进单次前向，导致测试时难以用几何证据纠错。PosePlaner用流匹配将位姿精化转为条件生成，以粗匹配和初始位姿为条件并融合多个假设，近似可微的RANSAC投票。它仅用双视图训练，却能作为流式多视图预测器的周期精化器且无需重训。实验表明可纠正前馈失败、提升对应求解器并降低长序列漂移。
papers.abstract_en: Recent multi-view Transformers (e.g., DUSt3R and VGGT) have advanced 3D reconstruction by scaling training data and model capacity from two views to many views and long sequences, subsuming the classical SfM/SLAM pipeline of feature extraction, matching, and pose estimation in a single feed-forward pass. Yet this subsumption hides the interfaces between pipeline stages---correspondences, geometry, and pose are entangled in a single forward pass, leaving supervised fine-tuning as the major path to improvement and offering no mechanism to correct predictions from geometric evidence at test time. We propose PosePlaner to close this gap by reviving the classical coupling between correspondences and pose via flow matching, treating pose refinement as a conditional generation problem that takes coarse geometric matches and initial pose as input condition and fuses the resulting pose hypotheses into a single refined estimate, providing a continuous, data-driven analog of RANSAC voting. Our method is trained efficiently on two-view data, yet serves as a periodic refiner for streaming n-view pose estimators with no retraining. Empirically, it corrects failures of feed-forward predictors, substantially improves correspondence-based solvers, and reduces accumulated drift in long streaming sequences.

papers.title_en: Finite-Step Geometry of Marginal-Preserving Velocity Fields in Generative Flows
papers.evidence: 生成流中速度场的有限步离散分析
papers.tldr: 生成流中不同速度场可在连续时间保持相同边缘分布，但数值离散后会分叉。本文固定边缘路径与数值方法，用投影修正方程刻画会改变边缘分布的局部积分误差，并给出更高边缘收敛阶的充分条件。针对仿射固定形状分布，刻画精确有限步可达性，导出谱障碍与最近可达的Wasserstein误差；对扩散概率流ODE构造保持精确边缘路径的斜分数扰动，并量化分数误差下的泄漏。高斯与混合实验验证了预测现象。
papers.abstract_en: Generative flows can admit different velocity fields that induce the same continuous marginal evolution but behave differently after numerical discretization. We study this finite-step non-equivalence while keeping the marginal path and numerical method fixed. Projected modified equations characterize the component of local integration error that changes the marginal law and give sufficient conditions for higher marginal convergence order. For affine fixed-shape distributions, we characterize exact finite-step reachability and derive spectral obstructions and sharp nearest-reachable Wasserstein errors. For diffusion probability-flow ODEs, we construct skew-score perturbations that preserve the exact marginal path under exact scores and quantify their leakage under score error. Controlled Gaussian and mixture experiments recover the predicted order, reachability, and obstruction phenomena.

papers.title_en: Hierarchical Diffusion for Camera-controlled Autoregressive Video Generation
papers.authors: Kaihua Chen, Yiming Gong, Deva Ramanan, Tarasha Khurana
papers.evidence: 扩散用于相机控制视频生成
papers.tldr: 针对单张图像生成相机可控长视频时，自回归模型会因远离真实帧的条件输入而误差累积，且显式6-DOF位姿条件易导致场景几何漂移。本文提出轻量框架WanAR+FixAR，将视频生成重述为warping-and-inpainting问题，并设计分层长上下文去噪：先基于近邻历史生成帧，再用时间下采样后的长程历史进行精修，从而低成本利用完整时序上下文。在RealEstate10k和DL3DV上，该方法优于现有相机控制长视频生成方法，输出时序稳定并与输入相机轨迹一致，说明分层扩散可在避免高开销的同时提升全局几何一致性。
papers.abstract_en: We address the task of long-video, camera-controlled generation from a single image. The dominant autoregressive paradigm suffers from two key limitations: (1) error accumulation over time, as distant frames are conditioned on previously generated outputs rather than ground truth, leading to drift; and (2) ambiguity in how to incorporate camera control. Standard solutions to both--such as self-forcing and conditioning on explicit 6-DOF poses--either incur significant computational overhead or produce drifting scene geometries over time. We propose a simple and lightweight framework that combines autoregressive generation (WanAR) with hierarchical long-context denoising (FixAR). To enforce scene geometry remains consistent with input cameras, we draw from feed-forward novel-view synthesis and reformulate video generation as a warping-and-inpainting problem. To mitigate drift, we introduce a hierarchical denoising strategy in which different stages condition on different temporal histories. Specifically, we first generate frames conditioned on the immediate past, and then refine them using a second denoiser conditioned on a temporally subsampled long-range history to enforce global consistency. This fine-to-coarse scheme enables each generated frame to effectively condition on the full temporal context without incurring a prohibitive cost. Experiments on RealEstate10k and DL3DV demonstrate that WanAR+FixAR outperforms prior methods for camera-controlled long-video generation, producing results that are both temporally stable and consistent with input camera trajectories.

papers.title_en: NAGO: Noise-Aware Generative Operator via Flow Matching
papers.authors: Guanyu Chen, Shengze Xu, Pengwei Liu, Xingyu Ren, Pengkai Wang, Antonios Armaou, Tieyong Zeng, Dong Ni
papers.evidence: 流匹配生成算子用于采样
papers.tldr: SPDE不变测度采样通常默认高斯源分布，少步生成精度受限。NAGO把源测度作为可设计变量，建立无穷维流匹配可容许条件，并给出谱匹配准则：源需足够粗糙以保证良定，再在已解析傅里叶模态上最小化协方差失配。三个随机场基准显示少步谱精度和分布/物理统计提升；Matern场消融将精确RK4预算从约30步降至3–5步，神经ODE评估减少6–10倍，为函数空间生成算子提供可分析、低成本的源设计思路。
papers.abstract_en: We introduce NAGO, a noise-aware generative operator for efficient sampling from invariant measures of stochastic partial differential equations (SPDEs) in function space. Our central idea is to treat the source measure as a design variable rather than a fixed Gaussian default. We establish admissibility conditions for well-defined infinite-dimensional flows and show that the finite-band source--target covariance ratio controls the spectral stiffness of the marginal velocity field. This analysis yields an admissibility-constrained spectral-matching rule: choose a source that is sufficiently rough for well-posedness, then minimize covariance mismatch over the resolved Fourier modes. On three representative stochastic-field benchmarks, this source design improves few-step spectral accuracy and several complementary distributional and physical statistics. In a controlled Matern-field ablation, it reduces the accurate RK4 budget from about 30 steps for Gaussian functional flow matching to 3--5 steps, a $6$--$10\times$ reduction in neural ODE evaluations. These gains are strongest for stationary multiscale fields and depend on the metric, resolution, and guidance protocol.

papers.title_en: AegisFlow: Training-Free Non-Myopic Path-Safe Guided Flow Matching
papers.authors: Kunpeng Liu, Boshi Zhang, Keyou You
papers.evidence: 免训练非短视路径安全引导流匹配
papers.tldr: 预训练扩散与流匹配模型生成质量高，但引导轨迹满足身份保持、避障等严格约束仍困难。现有免训练引导依赖短视最小范数控制器，只顾及即时约束，轨迹易贴边且难以优化目标。AegisFlow将引导生成重构为全局安全最优控制问题，把时变障碍函数融入全局代价，并近似求解HJB方程。实验在文本引导图像编辑与机器人规划上优于现有方法，更好兼顾目标对齐与约束满足。
papers.abstract_en: Pretrained generative models, such as diffusion and flow matching models, have demonstrated exceptional capabilities in synthesizing high-quality data. However, steering their generative trajectories to satisfy strict constraints--such as identity preservation in image editing or obstacle avoidance in robotics--remains fundamentally challenging. While recent training-free guidance methods enforce path-safety, they rely heavily on min-norm controllers that only account for immediate constraint satisfaction. These myopic approaches often yield suboptimal trajectories that hover dangerously close to the boundary, severely restricting the model's ability to optimize toward its target. In this paper, we propose AegisFlow, a training-free, non-myopic path-safe guidance framework that recasts guided generation as a safety-critical optimal control problem with global scope. By integrating a time-varying barrier function directly into the global cost functional, AegisFlow naturally enforces constraints along the entire generative path. To compute the global optimal control, we derive a tractable, mathematically grounded approximation of the Hamilton-Jacobi-Bellman (HJB) equation. Comprehensive experiments demonstrate that AegisFlow outperforms state-of-the-art methods across text-guided image manipulation and robotic planning, establishing a significantly better trade-off between target alignment and constraint satisfaction. Code is available at https://github.com/LiuKunpeng03/AegisFlow.

papers.title_en: SynthFaces: Balanced Large Scale Human Dataset
papers.authors: Sergey Karpukhin, Denis Bobkov, Kirill Morozov, Aibek Alanov
papers.evidence: 扩散与流匹配用于合成人脸数据集生成
papers.tldr: 真实人类数据集存在身份分布失衡与隐私风险，使身份保持生成等任务出现公平性缺陷。作者提出可控人脸数据生成流水线，在Arc2Face基础上引入身份嵌入流形上的flow matching生成模型。由此构建高度均衡的SynthFaces合成身份数据集，并以最近邻非泄漏指标验证身份分离。该工作为公平模型训练与个性化生成微调提供低隐私依赖的数据基础。
papers.abstract_en: The pursuit of fair and equitable AI in human-centric tasks is critically hindered by the inherent biases and privacy risks of real-world datasets, which offer imbalanced representations of identity and often contain sensitive personal information. Consequently, state-of-the-art generative models trained on this skewed data exhibit unfair performance, particularly in identity-preserving generation. In this work we propose a pipeline for controllable generation of dataset with diverse faces for generative models training and finetuning. We achieve this by expanding foundational Arc2Face diffusion model with a flow matching generative model in the manifold of identity embeddings. We demonstrate that such approach achieves both goals of generative fidelity and label diversity not present in real human-centric datasets. As a result we collect and further contextualize a highly balanced identity-centric dataset of humans named SynthFaces. By design, our released images and identities are synthetic, reducing direct reliance on real personal images; we empirically check identity separation with a nearest-neighbor non-leakage metric. We purpose it for training and tuning of fair models for various downstream tasks, and showcase its usability in finetuning an existing adapter-based method for personalized generation.
